entries: Come on then. @ and I already have an arrangement.
那就来吧。@ 和我早有约定。
Can I be blamed? It's lonely down here.
能怪我吗？这下面多孤单啊。
As does your need for endless conversation.
你对没完没了聊天的需求也一样。
You just said you wanted to be here.
你刚还说你想待在这里。
Why not? I have had little success in this part of the cave.
有何不可？在这一带洞穴里，我可没什么收获。
I was focused on the book. Do not forget our mission.
我方才专注在那本书上。别忘了我们的使命。
Welcome traveller! I see that you've met @. I'm sure she mentioned me.
欢迎，旅人！看来你见过 @ 了。她一定提起过我。
You shall soon see for yourself friend, since we are trapped down here.
你很快就会亲眼见到，朋友，反正我们都困在这下面了。
I have killed many of these rodents of peculiar size, but my need to slay goes unsatisfied.
这些个头古怪的啮齿动物，我已杀了不少，可我的杀戮之欲仍未餍足。
@ and I have been down here for as long as I can remember.
打我记事起，@ 和我就在这下面了。
Let me guess, you remember very little as well, yet are still driven towards some end?
让我猜猜，你也记不得多少，却仍被某种目标驱动着？
You probably wish to escape this place, but I came here to slay a monster.
你大概想逃离这里，可我来此，是为了斩杀一头怪物。
Also, I might have dropped the door key over the ledge.
另外，我可能把门钥匙掉到崖沿下面去了。
Maybe you two can sort out your personal problems without me present.
也许你们俩的私人问题，可以不必当着我解决。
This is still a dangerous place. Perhaps we can help each other.
这里毕竟仍是个危险的地方。也许我们可以互相帮衬。
Yes, let us call it that.
I have seen many large animals here, but monsters... do such things even exist?
这地方的大型动物我见过不少，可怪物……真有这种东西吗？
